text:
kira_support: FYI customer reported a regression after yesterday's rollout (v2.8). they say earlier system instructions and earlier user turns get dropped in long sessions, causing hallucinations and instruction loss. pasted their minimal repro below.

sam_eng_ml: thanks. can you paste the exact request payload + model + sdk version and an example session id?

kira_support: customer sent this snippet (redacted ids):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-2-large",
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a precise assistant. Always include a 3-step plan."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "Create a migration plan for two services."},
    {"role": "assistant", "content": "(step list)"},
    {"role": "user", "content": "Now combine the earlier constraints and include risk matrix."}
  ],
  "max_tokens": 8000,
  "session_id": "sess-abc-123"
}
```
customer says before rollout response included plan + risk matrix. after rollout assistant replies only with an unrelated paragraph and omits plan and risk matrix. they also saw repeated 429s for some long requests.

lee_runtime: @kira_support good catch. which region + routing variant did they land on? could be kernel change we rolled.

kira_support: region: us-west-2, routing: defaults (tier: hosted). logs attached by customer show trace id r-999888. they included latency spikes ~2.5s -> 8s just before 429s.

sam_eng_ml: quick theory: we shipped an aggressive KV-eviction/compact heuristic in the rollout to reduce memory for long-running sessions. if the system prompt gets evicted from KV cache earlier than expected, model won't get the system instruction and will ignore the 3-step plan requirement. also the 429s align with a new batching fallback that aborts very long prefix requests.

anya_billing: customer also flagged unexpected token overage charges from retried requests. did they get duplicate responses?

kira_support: customer says they saw the assistant re-ask for clarifications twice, generating extra tokens, then hit quota throttle. they escalated billing.

sam_eng_ml: can we reproduce? @lee_runtime can you run a canary with the exact session id and headers (content-length, sdk-version) and emulate their message length? give me kernel & eviction logs.

lee_runtime: running repro now on canary node (deploy-bot attached).

deploy-bot: canary run initiated by lee_runtime: node canary-usw-17, kernel=v2.8.3-fast, eviction-mode=aggressive, trace=r-999888

lee_runtime: repro steps I used:
1) send system + 3 user turns replicating the payload with max_tokens=8000
2) observe token accounting and KV-cache hits
3) force large context (simulate prior history ~30k tokens)

lee_runtime: initial run: we see KV-cache eviction at prefix offset ~28k leading to system prompt not being present when chunking resumed. logs:
```
EVict: prefix_offset=28124, reason=memory_pressure, retained_keys=224
KV_LOOKUP: system_prompt_presence=false
BATCH_ABORT: reason=prefix_too_large, req_id=sess-abc-123
```

sam_eng_ml: that matches the customer's symptom. hypothesis: new compacting heuristic miscalculates retention score for system tokens because we didn't weight system role strongly enough. this would explain instruction loss but still produce an output (hallucinated).

kira_support: customer wants ETA and rollback if needed. they're on a paid Dedicated evaluation tier.

anya_billing: if we roll back a change that reduces extra token billing, we should proactively credit the customer's unexpected overage. pls confirm numbers.

lee_runtime: temporary mitigation: bump retention threshold for system tokens for sessions > 20k context. i can push a config change to canary in ~30m. not a full rollback.

sam_eng_ml: also add a safe-guard: treat system & first 2 user turns as protected (never evict) until we have a smarter scoring. that'll prevent instruction loss while we debug scoring math.

kira_support: told customer we will apply a canary patch and monitor; asked for any failing request ids. they responded with 3 ids. forwarding now.

lee_runtime: patch applied to canary-usw-17: eviction-mode=conservative-protect-system. re-running reproducer.

deploy-bot: canary redeploy complete: node canary-usw-17, kernel=v2.8.4, eviction-mode=conservative-protect-system

lee_runtime: after patch: KV_LOOKUP: system_prompt_presence=true, no BATCH_ABORTs; latency stabilized. preliminary repro success (assistant includes plan + risk matrix).

sam_eng_ml: next steps:
- escalate to rollout team: revert aggressive heuristic from global rollout and filter it behind feature-flag. (action: sam_eng_ml)
- run audit for other sessions that may have incurred billing overages and flag customers. (action: anya_billing)
- create e2e regression test that protects system prompt across chunking and compaction. (action: sam_eng_ml + eng-test)
- postmortem with timeline and decision to not promote eviction heuristic until scoring validated. (action: kira_support + sam_eng_ml)

kira_support: customer updated: thanks, confirmed assistant returned correct content on canary. they accepted temporary mitigation and want final ETA for full rollback or safe rollout. i told them we'll follow up within 24h.

anya_billing: I'll compute credits for the 3 request ids and prepare a small goodwill credit while we investigate further.

sam_eng_ml: documenting root cause: KV eviction scoring undervalued system tokens leading to early eviction under high prefix sizes; secondary cause: new batching fallback caused 429s for very large prefix requests. fix: protect system tokens + feature-flag heuristic + metrics alert.

kira_support: thanks team. i'll keep the thread updated and coordinate with the customer for final sign-off. :white_check_mark:
